name: George F. Porter
role: Manager of the company store in Medora
bio: George F. Porter managed the company's store in Medora and made regular buying trips to Chicago, including a May 1884 trip to buy a $10,000 general stock and an annual purchasing tour in fall 1885. Frank Keeler kept his place during a five-week trip to New York and Chicago in early 1884. In July 1884 he received a carload of household furniture to move into one of the new cottages, and he and his wife traveled east together in 1884 and 1885.
